_comment: Canonical register of load-bearing figures, and of figures that have been
RETIRED. Two jobs: a single place to look up the current value of a number,
and a machine-checkable list of numbers that must no longer be quoted.
Why this exists: three separate figures in this repo were corrected in one
place and left standing in others -- 72 MB in five documents, 22x in four,
and DEC-023's 1,639/1,639 in three. Each was found by hand, weeks apart.
DEC-018's lesson is that a rule nothing checks is a rule that stops holding,
A retired figure may still APPEAR -- retracting a number requires naming it.
It must appear near a retraction marker (see the script). What is forbidden
is quoting it as though it were still true.
Adding an entry: retire a figure here in the same change that corrects it.
_counts_comment: Counts DERIVED from the repository, and the phrasings that assert them.
Separate from figures because nothing needs registering: the true value is
computed, so a document either agrees with the repo or it does not.
This caught the README claiming 'four research domains complete, eight
decisions recorded' when there were 13 and 24, alongside 'no service code
written' with two packages in the tree.
Volatile counts are deliberately absent. Test totals change on almost every
commit, so living documents say 'both suites passing' and exact numbers
appear only in dated CHANGELOG entries, which are snapshots and stay true.
